pre_registered_decision_rule.R1_invariant: identical output at all three values => IMMATERIAL, change nothing
pre_registered_decision_rule.R2_load_bearing: outputs differ => consult the textbook; its silence is re-checked here
pre_registered_decision_rule.R3_silent_stricter_wins: the strictest tested value is the one granting the FEWEST entries; monotonicity is ASSERTED against the measurement, and the run REFUSES to pick if it does not hold
pre_registered_decision_rule.R4_never_by_score: no agreement rate, fidelity headline, PnL, realized outcome or winner/loser label participates; ties break to the LOWER value, which assumes less
